subject: Post-demo: NimblePay fit notes, eval links, and regression mitigation proposal
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nimblepay.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: NimblePay fit notes, eval links, and regression mitigation proposal

Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clear context on your fraud-alert triage flows and the 95th percentile latency target (~350ms) for inline scoring. Quick recap and next steps: 

- Recommended model candidates: LlamaX-13B-qlora (baseline low-latency) and Red-Decoder-7B-optimized (better recall on short prompts).
- I've uploaded a short eval pack (prompts + scoring harness) to the shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/NimblePay-Eval-2026-12-14. The eval summary and the prompt set are attached to this thread.
- Key concern you flagged: subtle quality regressions after model micro-updates are unacceptable for production (esp. when labels are high cost). We propose a production guardrail: pin the serving variant for your account and run a staged canary after any model upgrade. See the proposed rollout below.

Immediate asks:
1) Please review the attached prompt_set (nimblepay_prompt_set_v1.csv) and tell us if we should include any merchant-specific templates.
2) Confirm if we should pin to a model snapshot on go-live (we recommend pinning for the first 30 days).

Proposed regression-mitigation play (short):
- Pin current model snapshot for NimblePay (v1.3.2) as the account default.
- Run any new model candidate as a 2% canary for 48 hours with automatic regression alerts (precision/recall deltas > 2% and manual QA review).
- If regression is observed, automatic rollback to pinned snapshot and notify your team + ours.

Attached: nimblepay_prompt_set_v1.csv, nimblepay_eval_summary_20261214.pdf

I'll follow up with sample outputs comparing the current production snapshot and the most recent nightly build.

Thanks,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nimblepay.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: NimblePay fit notes, eval links, and regression mitigation proposal

Jonas, thanks — this is helpful.

A few quick items:
- The prompt set looks good at a glance. I'll loop in our fraud SME to confirm merchant templates by EOD Wednesday.
- Pinning sounds like the right approach. We can't tolerate regressions at midnight on a high-volume weekend.
- Can you attach a sample of model outputs for a) current snapshot and b) the new candidate? We want to see differences for edge-case merchant IDs.

Also, latency: you mentioned the smaller decoder has better recall — can you share a quick latency profile (p50/p95) for both candidates on the same hardware profile? That will drive our selection.

Regards,
Alex
Head of Risk Ops, NimblePay
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nimblepay.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 13:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: NimblePay fit notes, eval links, and regression mitigation proposal

Alex — attached the sample outputs (sample_outputs_nimblepay_v1_vs_v2.txt) and a quick latency snapshot below. I ran both on a g5.2x instance (our baseline for hosted demos):

- LlamaX-13B-qlora (v1.3.2 pinned candidate): p50 = 110ms, p95 = 280ms
- Red-Decoder-7B-opt (nightly candidate): p50 = 95ms, p95 = 340ms

Observations: Red-Decoder shows lower median but higher tail due to tokenization differences on some merchant templates — we can mitigate with prefix caching for your high-frequency templates (we'd configure this in your tenant).

Key sample diffs in attachment include two edge-case merchant prompts where the nightly candidate changes label confidence materially (one false positive increase). Those are flagged in the sample_outputs file with line notes. Given this, I'd recommend:
- Pin to v1.3.2 now for safety.
- Schedule a 2% canary for Red-Decoder-7B-opt, run with the eval harness for 72 hours against your prompt set.
- If any regression above thresholds appears, automatic rollback and immediate notice.

I'll coordinate with engineering to schedule the pin and the canary window — Sean, can you confirm operational readiness for a 72-hour canary starting 2026-12-16?

Onward,
Jonas
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 15:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: NimblePay fit notes, eval links, and regression mitigation proposal

Jonas — forwarding the thread to Grace for a quick OK on the emergency pin + canary SLA.

On Mon, 14 Dec 2026 at 13:28, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — attached the sample outputs...

Grace — two quick asks from ops:
- Approve pinning NimblePay to snapshot v1.3.2 as their account default until the canary completes. This is a standard prod safety action; no infra changes beyond configuration.
- Approve an SLA exception for an expedited canary start on 2026-12-16 (we'll need a small ops window to run the harness and retain extended logs for 14 days).

If you prefer, we can start the canary next Tuesday instead — Alex previously asked for the 16th to align with their low-traffic window.

Thanks,
Sean
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@nimblepay.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: NimblePay fit notes, eval links, and regression mitigation proposal

Thanks for the context. Approved: pin NimblePay to v1.3.2 and run the 72-hour 2% canary starting 2026-12-16 as requested.

Operational notes:
- We'll enable prefix caching for the templates highlighted in nimblepay_prompt_set_v1.csv to reduce p95 tail for Red-Decoder during canary.
- Engineering will keep extended logs for 14 days; we'll alert your team for any precision/recall delta > 1.5% (stricter than the 2% Jonas proposed, given the potential cost of missed fraud).

Alex — go ahead and confirm the merchant templates by EOD Wednesday and we'll lock the schedule.

Grace O'Connor
VP, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
